experiment: Frozen EG2: one nearest neighbor, one hop
test_use: Exploratory follow-up on the same previously inspected 300 test queries; no new test results may select parameters or methods.
selection: Best positive configuration per family by development Recall@10, then nDCG@10, then fixed grid order. Overall deployment choice includes the unchanged cosine baseline first; ties retain the earlier choice.
constraints: Frozen encoder and identical cached vectors. Corpus graph uses exactly one self-excluding nearest neighbor per document; all query graph operations use one hop only. Graph feedback performs a second full-corpus search; diffusion ranks the union of direct candidates and their one-hop neighbors.
uncertainty: Paired query bootstrap with fixed configurations; four positive families additionally receive Bonferroni 98.75% Recall@10 intervals and Holm-corrected two-sided sign-randomization p values. These do not correct historical test reuse or query dependence.
prior_near_comparator: Use the previously locked NEAR model and reported runs; its original selection objective was nDCG@10, unlike the new recall-first experiment.
